posts.name: Ankit
posts.cooked:
I was appearing for the OPPE exam today and had joined the proctored session successfully.

My verification was completed, and I was able to attempt the exam for approximately 30 minutes.

However, during the exam, my phone overheated and suddenly switched off. This caused the meeting to disconnect and also disrupted my internet connection.

As a result, my virtual machine stopped working, and I was unable to continue the exam.

Realizing the issue, I exited the exam by closing the tab to avoid flagged as malpractice. I sincerely apologize for the disruption caused.

I kindly request you to consider my situation, mark my current attempt score as zero, and allow me to reattempt the OPPE.

@sayan @21f3000759

posts.name: Shalini A Ramesh
posts.cooked: In the exam portal my camera did not work, informed the proctor immediately. Could not solve the issue, also did a screen share with the proctor, and solved only a single question. Please consider this and provide me an opportunity for reattempt

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked: If you have solved only 1 question, you will be automatically given a re-attempt chance as your score will be less than 40

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked: Yes, you will if your score is less than 40 and you made a submission.

posts.name: MONIKA R
posts.cooked: @21f3000759 Mam, made submission in the sense “Submission successful” in green right irrespective of pass or failure of test cases?

posts.name: Shalini A Ramesh
posts.cooked: Thank you sir, but it was really bad luck. I had checked the camera . Thanks for the confirmation
